newsitem.title: FRANCE: Freighter flights increase at Paris airport in 96.
newsitem.headline: Freighter flights increase at Paris airport in 96.

text.p: The number of freighter flights operating at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly in 1996, totalled 19,423 an increase of 4.1 percent on the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
Freighter flights at CDG last year totalled 17,853, an increase of 12.5 percent on 1995.
The number of freighter flights at Orly airport fell by 43.7 percent to 1,570 flights.

Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.2 percent of global flights operating at the Paris airports in 1996, compared to 3.3 percent in the previous year. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
